description: Every currently valid TLS certificate publicly issued for one domain, read from the Certificate Transparency logs: issuer, validity window, days to expiry, revocation status and every hostname each certificate covers. It reports what was ISSUED, which is how you find certificates you did not know existed - not what the server is serving today. No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

domain.description: The domain to look up. A full URL or an email address is accepted and reduced to its host.

subdomains.description: Also return certificates issued for subdomains. Defaults to false.

name: red_cert
title: TLS certificate lookup (Certificate Transparency)
